system.description:
FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Mind Points
  • Ritualism rituals

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise. Adopted from Project FU's Elementalist counterpart.)

ELEMENTALIST SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000098]{Elemental Magic} 【Max SL 10】

Each level learns one Elementalist spell. Offensive spells use (INS + WLP) for the Magic Check.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000099]{Cataclysm} 【Max SL 3】

Casting an Instantaneous spell with an arcane weapon equipped: raise its cost by up to (SL × 10) MP for +5 damage per extra 10 MP.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000100]{Magical Artillery} 【Max SL 3】

Offensive spells cast with an arcane weapon equipped gain +(SL × 2) to the Magic Check.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000101]{Spellblade} 【Max SL 3】

Single-target offensive spells costing (SL × 20) MP or less may roll the Magic Check on an equipped non-arcane weapon's Accuracy formula, +(SL) if that formula uses Dexterity.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000102]{Ritual Scrolls} 【Max SL 3】

When performing a Ritual, +10 MP stores it in a scroll (hold up to SL). Whoever holds the scroll releases it for 10 MP; used in conflict it takes an action and a Clock as normal. Destroyed on use.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000103]{Mote of Creation} 【Max SL 3】

On a rest, take a spark of Air, Earth, Fire or Water. Spend it once before your next rest for that element's effect — die replacement, damage reduction, and kin.
